spans.s:
नैक a. (न-एक) Not one or alone;
mostly in comp.; ˚आत्मन् m., ˚रूपः,
˚शृगः epithets of the Supreme Being.
--कः An epithet of Viṣṇu.
--Comp.
--चर a. living in society, gregarious.
--भावाश्रय a. fickle, changeable.
--भेद a. manifold, various. See
under न also.

नैकधा ind. In various ways,
variously.

नैकशस् ind.
1 In great numbers.
--2 Repeatedly, often, frequently.

नैकटिक a. (की f.) Adjacent,
near, contiguous.
--कः An ascetic or
Bhikṣu;
